full_text_en:
Guanghua Zhi Dou Factory of Ganguan Town, Haicheng City, Liaoning Province — Application for Confirmation of State Compensation

Ruling Summary

1. Pursuant to the provisions of Article 31 of the State Compensation Law of the People's Republic of China and Article 2 of the Interpretation of the Supreme People's Court on Several Issues concerning the Implementation of the State Compensation Law of the People's Republic of China by People's Courts, the State assumes compensatory liability only if, in the course of civil or administrative proceedings, a People's Court unlawfully adopts compulsory measures or preservative measures, or commits errors in enforcing judgments, rulings, or other effective legal documents, and thereby causes damage.

2. Where a party lawfully asserts its own legitimate rights and interests, and after a People's Court renders a judgment in its favor, the party applies for confirmation of State Compensation on the grounds that the time for enforcement has passed and the judgment is difficult to enforce, such application does not fall within the scope of cases for confirmation of State Compensation accepted by People's Courts; the People's Court shall not accept it; if already accepted, the application shall be dismissed according to law.

Ruling of the Supreme People's Court

(2007) Que Shen Zi No. 1

Applicant for Confirmation: Guanghua Zhi Dou Factory of Ganguan Town, Haicheng City, Liaoning Province, domiciled at Ganguan Town, Haicheng City, Liaoning Province.

Legal Representative: Zhou Changbin, Factory Director.

The applicant for confirmation, Guanghua Zhi Dou Factory of Ganguan Town, Haicheng City, Liaoning Province (hereinafter referred to as the Zhi Dou Factory), applied for confirmation of unlawful acts for State Compensation on the grounds that during the trial of the debt dispute between it and Taonan City Department Store of Jilin Province and Li Zhuoshuo, although the Jilin High People's Court ultimately corrected the errors in its original judgment through retrial, the time for enforcement had been lost, the judgment was difficult to enforce, and losses were caused to it. The Jilin High People's Court rendered a ruling on May 6, 2005, (2005) Ji Que Shen Zi No. 7, refusing to confirm the unlawful nature of its judicial acts. The Zhi Dou Factory, dissatisfied, filed a petition with this Court on the grounds that the court had erroneously refused to confirm the unlawful nature of the judicial acts for which it had applied for confirmation.

Upon review, this Court finds that for erroneous adjudications that may occur in civil proceedings, the Civil Procedure Law provides relief procedures for correction. In this case, the party, the Zhi Dou Factory, lawfully asserted its own legitimate rights and interests and obtained support from the court. After winning the case, it could still lawfully exhaust all compulsory means against the property of the judgment debtor at the time of winning; whether the judgment debtor had the ability to perform the debt shall not result in the State assuming compensatory liability. Pursuant to the provisions of Article 31 of the State Compensation Law of the People's Republic of China and Article 4 of the Provisions of the Supreme People's Court on Several Issues concerning the Trial of Cases of Confirmation of State Compensation by People's Courts (Trial Implementation), the State assumes compensatory liability only if, in the course of civil or administrative proceedings, a People's Court unlawfully adopts compulsory measures or preservative measures, or commits errors in enforcing judgments, rulings, or other effective legal documents, and thereby causes damage. Applications for confirmation within this scope fall within the acceptance scope of cases for confirmation of unlawful acts for State Compensation. The application for confirmation filed by the Zhi Dou Factory in this case does not fall within the acceptance scope as provided by the aforesaid laws. Therefore, the Jilin High People's Court correctly found that the application for confirmation in this case did not fall within the acceptance scope as provided by law, but it was improper not to render a decision of non-acceptance according to law. After acceptance, it was also improper not to dismiss the application for confirmation that should have been rejected. This Court, pursuant to the provisions of Article 31 of the State Compensation Law of the People's Republic of China and Article 4, Item (5) of the Provisions of the Supreme People's Court on Several Issues concerning the Trial of Cases of Confirmation of State Compensation by People's Courts (Trial Implementation), renders the following ruling:

1. The ruling of the Jilin High People's Court, (2005) Ji Que Shen Zi No. 7, is hereby set aside.

2. The application for confirmation of State Compensation filed by Guanghua Zhi Dou Factory of Ganguan Town, Haicheng City, Liaoning Province is hereby dismissed.

This ruling shall become legally effective upon service.

Presiding Judge: Jiang Hua
Acting Judge: Li Guishun
Acting Judge: Ma Dongxu

May 17, 2007

Court Clerk: Zhang Lihua

Jiang Hua, Senior Judge: born in 1951, Master of Laws, served as a Judge of the Supreme People's Court from 1997.
